idle_diagnostic.note: Real Tk method diagnostic on the same closed 10001-event synthetic history. Timing is not end-to-end recording latency or a CPU percentage. Working-source preliminary observations retained separately.

source_binding: Measured runtime, recorder probe, stage probe, point probe and entry bytes match measured commit Git blobs. Documentation-only publication must preserve these blobs.
sample_definition: Each mode/scale has 3 distinct AVAILABLE request/prefix batches from repeated synthetic composition, not statistically independent live games. Per-input samples (45/48) are not decision counts; p95/p99 with 3 decisions equal observed maximum.
component_note: Replay/prefix/append stages are totals per input. Recovery includes nested validation and is executed once per batch; zero means not executed on that request. Input-to-commit contains queue wait and validation. IPC includes logging/serialization/transfer/deserialization/scheduling. Parent publication/drawing and validation overlap; do not sum them.
conditions: Visible window; main auto kept on; PP/21+3 disabled; old enabled=true settings unchanged; actual A-9/T buttons and normal key callbacks; default spawned recorder; same frozen history scales; no math budget changes or validation shortcut.
